facts.text: In-state students who finish in the top 10% of their high school graduating class and achieve an ACT composite of 24 or higher earn guaranteed admission.

sources.title: In-state Policy Guaranteed Admission
sources.quote: As part of our mission to make a college education more accessible to in-state students, UT will guarantee admission to in-state students who apply by our early action deadlines and meet certain requirements.

facts.text: The Tri-Star Scholarship Program combines awards including Pledge, Promise, and Flagship to cover full in-state tuition and mandatory fees for eligible Tennessee students.

sources.title: Your Guide to Affording the University of Tennessee, Knoxville
sources.quote: Tri-Star Scholarship Program: A combination of programs, including Pledge, Promise, and Flagship scholarships, that can cover full in-state tuition and mandatory fees for eligible Tennessee students when stacked with HOPE and other aid.

facts.text: The Distinguished Tennessean Award covers full tuition and mandatory fees for one standout student from each of Tennessee's 95 counties.

sources.title: Your Guide to Affording the University of Tennessee, Knoxville
sources.quote: Distinguished Tennessean Award: Full in-state tuition and mandatory fees for one standout student from each of Tennessee's 95 counties.
